description: Judge whether a running process can hold a dimension inside its tolerance. Reports Cp and Cpk from within-subgroup sigma and Pp and Ppk from overall sigma — the second pair is the overall figure many customer reports quote — each with a 95% confidence interval, an upper bound on parts per million out of spec, and an Anderson–Darling normality check. Estimators follow Minitab's defaults. The verdict takes the lower of Cpk and Ppk, so a mean that drifted during the run is not called capable. No verdict is given when the data cannot support one (no limit, zero spread, badly non-normal data). One specification limit is enough. Sample at least 25 consecutive parts without adjusting the process.

study_code.description: A study as the Lab card encodes it; use instead of the measurements (samples, usl, lsl, target, subgroupSize, withinMethod)

subgroupSize.description: Consecutive measurements per rational subgroup. Omit or 1 for individuals (within sigma from the moving range).

target.description: Nominal from the drawing. Used only to sanity-check it against usl/lsl (a warning when it falls outside them) — not carried into the share link, since the snapshot has no field for it.

withinMethod.description: Within-sigma estimator when subgroupSize > 1: pooled standard deviation (default, as Minitab) or R-bar/d2.
